title: Register-copy loop instruction
statement: Given seven registers, a designated source and destination register, an exit label, and a label for each of seven phases, this definition assigns an instruction to each phase. The instruction tests whether the source is zero, transfers one unit from the source to the destination while it is nonzero, and then restores the source while consuming the same number of units from the zero register; it exits when the zero register reaches zero.
hypotheses_covered: source and destination registers are among seven registers
